integrity: Analytic parity/residue proof and exact superoperator-diagonalization argument; a dependency-free numerical checker supplies finite corroboration rather than universal certification. Previously known circulant mixing and Hamiltonian spectrum are credited.
scientific_limitations: The result minimizes an asymptotic limsup coefficient, not the finite-time convergence error at every time.
No trace-norm, diamond-norm, noisy-system or multibody generalization is proved.
The Fourier rank-one dephasing reference is the asymptotic channel only at nondegenerate fluxes.
Independent scientific validation and publication-priority determination have not been performed.
scientific_scope: One clean uniform nearest-neighbor quantum cycle, any integer size at least three, any positive hopping strength, static Peierls flux, induced Hilbert-Schmidt Cesaro channel norm.
title: Sharp parity-dependent magnetic-flux design for quantum-ring dephasing
